name: B10-0477/2025 (S&D) – Renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a renewed partnership between Europe and Africa ahead of a summit in Angola in November 2025. It asks both sides to work as equals on peace, trade, climate, migration, health and education. It wants promises kept, with parliaments and citizens involved. It also urges Europe to keep funding development aid and to help African countries with debt. The text is the Parliament's position, not a law.

- The Parliament sets out its wishes for the EU-Africa summit; no law changes yet.
- It affects African and European governments, parliaments and people.
- Next: leaders meet in Angola on 24–25 November 2025.
